ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
protocol_type: Three-layer half-duplex contactless command/response protocol. Layer 2 (ISO 14443-2): 13.56 MHz carrier + modulation. Layer 3 (ISO 14443-3): anti-collision and selection — short frames (REQA / WUPA / HLTA), standard frames (SELECT / cascade), bit-frame anti-collision. Layer 4 (ISO 14443-4): T=CL Block Transmission Protocol with I-Block / R-Block / S-Block carrying application APDUs.

frame_types_type_a.name: Short frame
frame_types_type_a.purpose: Initial polling / wake / halt — no parity, no CRC.
frame_types_type_a.used_for: REQA (0x26), WUPA (0x52), and certain proprietary commands.

frame_types_type_a.name: Standard frame
frame_types_type_a.bits: N×9 (N bytes, LSB-first, each followed by 1 odd-parity bit) + 2 × (8+1) CRC_A
frame_types_type_a.purpose: All Layer-3 anti-collision/selection traffic and Layer-4 T=CL blocks.
frame_types_type_a.used_for: SELECT, ATQA carry, SAK carry, RATS, ATS, I-Block, R-Block, S-Block.

frame_types_type_a.name: Anti-collision (bit-oriented) frame
frame_types_type_a.bits: 16 to (5×8+5) bits, with NVB indicating split point
frame_types_type_a.purpose: Split SELECT — PCD sends part, PICC completes the rest, supporting bit-position collision resolution.
frame_types_type_a.used_for: ANTICOLLISION CL1/CL2/CL3 (SEL byte + NVB byte + partial UID-CLn[]+ partial BCC).

layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.name: REQA
layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.description: Request Command, Type A — wake any PICC in IDLE.

layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.name: WUPA
layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.description: Wake-Up Command, Type A — wake any PICC in IDLE or HALT.

layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.name: HLTA
layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.description: HALT Command, Type A — instruct selected PICC to enter HALT state.

layer3_atqa_format.transmit_order: LSB byte 1 first then byte 2; bits LSB-first within each byte.

byte_1_bits.description: Which of the 5 anti-collision frame variants the PICC supports — bit-set position indicates support.
Reserved for future use; set to 0.
00 = single (4 B), 01 = double (7 B), 10 = triple (10 B), 11 = RFU.

byte_2_bits.description: Vendor-defined classification (NXP uses these to coarse-classify Classic/Plus/Ultralight/DESFire).

common_values.interpretation: 4-byte UID, MIFARE Classic 1K or MIFARE Plus SL1 2K
4-byte UID, MIFARE Classic 4K or MIFARE Plus SL1 4K

layer3_select_cascade_commands_type_a.purpose: Anti-collision and SELECT for the 4 first bytes of UID.
Anti-collision and SELECT for UID bytes 4..7 (for 7- or 10-byte UID).
Anti-collision and SELECT for UID bytes 7..9 (for 10-byte UID).

fields.name: NVB
fields.description: Number of Valid Bits: high nibble = full bytes, low nibble = additional bits.

fields.name: UID-CLn[0..3]
fields.value: UID bytes for this CL (CT byte if not final CL)
fields.description: UID-CL1[0]=0x88 for 7-byte UID; UID-CL2[0..3] = UID bytes 3..6.

bits_msb_first.description: 1 = PICC supports T=CL; 0 = PICC is Layer-3 only.
Reserved (per NXP AN10833 §1.4 note 4: future re-use possible).
Used by NXP to distinguish Classic 1K vs 4K vs Plus SL2 sub-variants.
Used by NXP for capacity / variant encoding.

well_known_values.meaning: MIFARE Ultralight / Ultralight C / Ultralight EV1 / NTAG21x — no ISO 14443-4.
UID not complete (Cascade Tag follows) — intermediate Cascade Level reply.
MIFARE Classic 1K (and MIFARE Plus SL1 2K / SE).
ISO 14443-4 compliant — MIFARE DESFire / DESFire Light / MIFARE Plus SL3 / JCOP / generic Type-4 tag.

layer3_anticollision_loop_summary: 2. PICC(s) reply with ATQA (2 bytes); UID-size bits indicate single / double / triple.
3. PCD enters Cascade Level 1 (SEL = 0x93) — bit-frame anti-collision.
4. PCD sends SEL + NVB (starts at 0x20 = 0 valid UID bits) → PICCs reply UID-CL1[0..3] + BCC.
5. If bit collision detected at bit position k: PCD records [bits 0..k-1] from PICCs, sets bit k = 1 (or 0), updates NVB to k+1, retransmits.
6. Loop until NVB = 0x70 (40 valid bits = full UID-CL1 + BCC) — only one PICC remains.
7. PCD sends full SELECT (NVB = 0x70 + the resolved UID-CL1 + BCC + CRC_A) → PICC responds with SAK.
8. If SAK bit 3 = 1: UID-CL1[0] was Cascade Tag 0x88; advance to Cascade Level 2 (SEL = 0x95) and repeat.
9. After the final Cascade Level: the PCD has the complete UID and SAK; the PICC is in ACTIVE state.
10. If SAK bit 6 = 1: PCD may activate Layer 4 with RATS (0xE0 + PARAM); PICC replies with ATS.

fields_command.name: PARAM
fields_command.description: FSDI 0..8 encodes PCD max frame size (16..256 B); CID is 0..14 logical channel.

ats_byte_layout.name: T0
ats_byte_layout.description: Interface bytes present bitmap: b8 = TA(1), b7 = TB(1), b6 = TC(1); b5:b1 = FSCI (PICC max frame size).

ats_byte_layout.name: TA(1) (optional)
ats_byte_layout.description: Bit-rate support: DS/DR support for 212/424/848 kbps PICC→PCD / PCD→PICC.

ats_byte_layout.name: TB(1) (optional)
ats_byte_layout.description: FWI (Frame Waiting Integer, b8:b5) + SFGI (Startup Frame Guard Time Integer, b4:b1).

layer4_ats_format.fwi_meaning: Frame Waiting Time FWT = (256 × 16 / fc) × 2^FWI; valid FWI 0..14; 15 RFU. fc = 13.56 MHz.

layer4_t_cl_blocks.name: I-Block
layer4_t_cl_blocks.purpose: Information block — carries chained or single APDU. N = block number (1-bit alternating). B = chaining (1 = more follows). C = CID present (1).

layer4_t_cl_blocks.name: R-Block
layer4_t_cl_blocks.purpose: ACK (R(ACK)) / NAK (R(NAK)) — block-number aware. R = 0 for ACK, 1 for NAK.

layer4_t_cl_blocks.name: S-Block
layer4_t_cl_blocks.purpose: S(DESELECT) — PCD requests PICC to release; S(WTX) — PICC requests more wait time.

layer4_block_format.block_number_field: PCB bit 1 is a 1-bit alternating block number; PCD and PICC each maintain their own counter; mismatch indicates lost block.

type_b_command_summary.name: REQB / WUPB
type_b_command_summary.description: Polling for Type B. AFI = Application Family Identifier; PARAM b5:b4 = number of slots N; b1:b3 = REQB (000) or WUPB (001).

type_b_command_summary.name: ATQB
type_b_command_summary.fields: 0x50 + PUPI (4 B) + Application Data (4 B) + Protocol Info (4 B) + CRC_B
type_b_command_summary.description: Answer to REQB/WUPB. PUPI is the Type-B equivalent of UID (Pseudo-Unique PICC Identifier).

type_b_command_summary.name: ATTRIB
type_b_command_summary.description: PCD selects a specific PICC by PUPI and negotiates rates + FSCI + CID.

crc_a_definition.covers: all frame bytes after SOF up to but excluding the CRC itself; CRC then appended LSB-first.

crc_b_definition.covers: all frame bytes after SOF up to but excluding the CRC.

msb_or_lsb_first: LSB-first on Type A wire; LSB-first on Type B wire; parity bit (Type A only) follows every byte.
valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no VALID/READY handshake on the air interface; framing uses SOF + parity (Type A) or SOF + EGT (Type B) + CRC.
PCD-side flow control via Frame Waiting Time (FWT); if PICC needs longer, it transmits S(WTX) with multiplier.
Block-number alternation on T=CL detects lost block; R(NAK) requests retransmission.

frame_format.type_a_short_frame: SOF (1 LOW pulse) + 7 data bits LSB-first + EOF (1 LOW pulse).
frame_format.type_a_standard_frame: SOF + repeat[ byte (8 bits LSB-first) + odd parity bit ] + CRC_A (LSB-first 16 bits, each followed by parity) + EOF.
frame_format.type_a_anti_collision: SOF + bytes-up-to-collision + (collision bit decided by PCD or shared) + remaining bits from PICC + EOF (no CRC for partial frames).
frame_format.type_b_frame: SOF (10-11 ETU of 0) + char[ start(0) + 8 data LSB-first + stop(1) + 2 EGT ETU of HIGH ] + CRC_B + EOF (10-11 ETU of 0).

channels.name: RF (air carrier)
channels.direction: PCD → field; PICC modulates load → PCD
channels.description: Single inductively-coupled 13.56 MHz channel; PCD and PICC share the carrier.

channels.name: RF subcarrier
channels.description: 847.5 kHz subcarrier (fc/16) used by PICC to encode response bits.

command_set_layer_summary.layer_2_iso14443_2: Modulation + carrier; no commands at this layer — all encoding parameters.
command_set_layer_summary.layer_3_iso14443_3_type_a: REQA / WUPA / ATQA / ANTICOLLISION (SEL+NVB partial) / SELECT (SEL+NVB full) / SAK / HLTA.
command_set_layer_summary.layer_3_iso14443_3_type_b: REQB / WUPB / ATQB / ATTRIB / Slot-MARKER / HLTB.
command_set_layer_summary.layer_4_iso14443_4: RATS / ATS / PPS-REQ / PPS-RSP / I-Block (carries application APDU) / R-Block (ACK/NAK) / S(DESELECT) / S(WTX).
command_set_layer_summary.layer_application_mifare_classic: AUTH KeyA/KeyB (0x60/0x61) → READ (0x30) / WRITE (0xA0) / DECREMENT (0xC0) / INCREMENT (0xC1) / TRANSFER (0xB0) — proprietary, runs above Layer 3 without T=CL.
command_set_layer_summary.layer_application_mifare_ultralight_ntag: GetVersion (0x60) / READ (0x30) / FAST_READ (0x3A) / WRITE (0xA2) / COMPATIBILITY_WRITE (0xA0) / PWD_AUTH (0x1B).
command_set_layer_summary.layer_application_mifare_desfire: Wrapped in T=CL I-Block; AuthenticateAES (0xAA) / SelectApplication (0x5A) / ReadData (0xBD) / WriteData (0x3D) / GetVersion (0x60) / GetUID (0x51).
